import cyclopts
from cyclopts.validators import Bounds

app = cyclopts.App()

@app.command
def serve(port: int = cyclopts.Parameter(validator=Bounds(min=1024, max=65535))):
    """Start the server on the specified port."""
    print(f"Server running on port {port}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
